claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: PCI-34051 is a highly HDAC8-selective inhibitor that induces caspase-dependent apoptosis only in T-cell lymphoma/leukemia lines via a PLCgamma1- and calcium-dependent mechanism, with no histone or tubulin acetylation, so at 2.5 uM it should kill only a narrow subset of T-cell-derived lines.
